title: Project P.I.T.T. Secret Ending Guide — END?, Elevator Code & Route
description: How to reach Project P.I.T.T.'s Secret Ending (END?) and why the elevator uses a save-specific keypad code.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Secret Ending Guide — END?, Elevator Code & Route
quickAnswer: END? is the Secret Ending; the route culminates at an elevator that requires a save-specific four-digit keypad code (2640 is not universal).

facts.label: END? meaning
facts.value: Newer achievement information identifies END? as the Secret Ending; treat END? as the game's secret ending rather than conflating it with END!.

facts.label: Route
facts.value: camera / surveillance progression → upper exploration → Mystery Boxes → 3 Fuses → 200kg → Percentage Pipe → later minigame / production progression → UV-related clue progression → elevator access / keycard → save-specific four-digit keypad code → Secret Ending route.

facts.label: Code
facts.value: The elevator requires a save-specific four-digit keypad code; 2640 is not a universal solution. Use the Keycard + UV Light method to reveal your save’s digits — see the Elevator Code guide for why 2640 fails and how to find your code. Entry order (if needed): Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly.

facts.label: Next if the code fails
facts.value: If the keypad code fails, consult the Elevator Code guide rather than looking for a universal internet code. If you're stuck earlier, return to the last completed progression stage (for example Percentage Pipe, 200kg, or the fuses).
